4	package api // import "miniflux.app/v2/internal/api"
5	
6	import (
7		json_parser "encoding/json"
8		"errors"
9		"net/http"
10	
11		"miniflux.app/v2/internal/http/request"
12		"miniflux.app/v2/internal/http/response"
13		"miniflux.app/v2/internal/model"
14		"miniflux.app/v2/internal/storage"
15		"miniflux.app/v2/internal/validator"
16	)
17	
18	func (h *handler) createAPIKeyHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
19		userID := request.UserID(r)
20	
21		var apiKeyCreationRequest model.APIKeyCreationRequest
22		if err := json_parser.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&apiKeyCreationRequest); err != nil {
23			response.JSONBadRequest(w, r, err)
24			return
25		}
26	
27		if validationErr := validator.ValidateAPIKeyCreation(h.store, userID, &apiKeyCreationRequest); validationErr != nil {
28			response.JSONBadRequest(w, r, validationErr.Error())
29			return
30		}
31	
32		apiKey, err := h.store.CreateAPIKey(userID, apiKeyCreationRequest.Description)
33		if err != nil {
34			response.JSONServerError(w, r, err)
35			return
36		}
37	
38		response.JSONCreated(w, r, apiKey)
39	}
40	
41	func (h *handler) getAPIKeysHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
42		userID := request.UserID(r)
43		apiKeys, err := h.store.APIKeys(userID)
44		if err != nil {
45			response.JSONServerError(w, r, err)
46			return
47		}
48		response.JSON(w, r, apiKeys)
49	}
50	
51	func (h *handler) deleteAPIKeyHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
52		userID := request.UserID(r)
53		apiKeyID := request.RouteInt64Param(r, "apiKeyID")
54		if apiKeyID == 0 {
55			response.JSONBadRequest(w, r, errors.New("invalid API key ID"))
56			return
57		}
58	
59		if err := h.store.DeleteAPIKey(userID, apiKeyID); err != nil {
60			if errors.Is(err, storage.ErrAPIKeyNotFound) {
61				response.JSONNotFound(w, r)
62				return
63			}
64			response.JSONServerError(w, r, err)
65			return
66		}
67		response.NoContent(w, r)
68	}

15	)
16	
17	type middleware struct {
18		store *storage.Storage
19	}
20	
21	func newMiddleware(s *storage.Storage) *middleware {
22		return &middleware{s}
23	}
24	func (m *middleware) withCORSHeaders(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
25		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
26			w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
27			w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS")
28			w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "X-Auth-Token, Authorization, Content-Type, Accept")
29			if r.Method == http.MethodOptions {
30				w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Max-Age", "3600")
31				response.NoContent(w, r)
32				return
33			}
34			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
35		})
36	}
37	
38	func (m *middleware) validateAPIKeyAuth(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
39		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
40			clientIP := request.ClientIP(r)
41			token := r.Header.Get("X-Auth-Token")
42	
43			if token == "" {
44				slog.Debug("[API] Skipped API token authentication because no API Key has been provided",
45					slog.String("client_ip", clientIP),
46					slog.String("user_agent", r.UserAgent()),
47					slog.String("request_uri", r.RequestURI),
48				)
49				next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
50				return
51			}
52	
53			user, err := m.store.UserByAPIKey(token)
54			if err != nil {
55				response.JSONServerError(w, r, err)
56				return
57			}
58	
59			if user == nil {
60				slog.Warn("[API] No user found with the provided API key",
61					slog.Bool("authentication_failed", true),
62					slog.String("client_ip", clientIP),
63					slog.String("user_agent", r.UserAgent()),
64					slog.String("request_uri", r.RequestURI),
65				)
66				response.JSONUnauthorized(w, r)
67				return
68			}
69	
70			slog.Info("[API] User authenticated successfully with the API Token Authentication",
71				slog.Bool("authentication_successful", true),
72				slog.String("client_ip", clientIP),
73				slog.String("user_agent", r.UserAgent()),
74				slog.String("username", user.Username),
75				slog.String("request_uri", r.RequestURI),
76			)
77	
78			m.store.SetLastLogin(user.ID)
79			m.store.SetAPIKeyUsedTimestamp(user.ID, token)
80	
81			ctx := r.Context()
82			ctx = context.WithValue(ctx, request.UserIDContextKey, user.ID)
83			ctx = context.WithValue(ctx, request.UserTimezoneContextKey, user.Timezone)
84			ctx = context.WithValue(ctx, request.IsAdminUserContextKey, user.IsAdmin)
85			ctx = context.WithValue(ctx, request.IsAuthenticatedContextKey, true)
86	
87			next.ServeHTTP(w, r.WithContext(ctx))
88		})
89	}
90	
91	func (m *middleware) validateBasicAuth(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
92		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
93			if request.IsAuthenticated(r) {
94				next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
95				return
96			}
97	
98			w.Header().Set("WWW-Authenticate", `Basic realm="Restricted"`)
99	
100			clientIP := request.ClientIP(r)
101			username, password, authOK := r.BasicAuth()
102			if !authOK {
103				slog.Warn("[API] No Basic HTTP Authentication header sent with the request",
104					slog.Bool("authentication_failed", true),
105					slog.String("client_ip", clientIP),
106					slog.String("user_agent", r.UserAgent()),
107					slog.String("request_uri", r.RequestURI),
108				)
109				response.JSONUnauthorized(w, r)
110				return
111			}
112	
113			if config.Opts.DisableLocalAuth() {
114				slog.Warn("[API] Blocking Basic HTTP Authentication attempt, local auth is disabled",
115					slog.Bool("authentication_failed", true),
116					slog.String("client_ip", clientIP),
117					slog.String("user_agent", r.UserAgent()),
118					slog.String("request_uri", r.RequestURI),
119				)
120				response.JSONUnauthorized(w, r)
121				return
122			}
123	
124			if username == "" || password == "" {
125				slog.Warn("[API] Empty username or password provided during Basic HTTP Authentication",
126					slog.Bool("authentication_failed", true),
127					slog.String("client_ip", clientIP),
128					slog.String("user_agent", r.UserAgent()),
129					slog.String("request_uri", r.RequestURI),
130				)
131				response.JSONUnauthorized(w, r)
132				return
133			}
134	
135			if err := m.store.CheckPassword(username, password); err != nil {
136				slog.Warn("[API] Invalid username or password provided during Basic HTTP Authentication",
137					slog.Bool("authentication_failed", true),
138					slog.String("client_ip", clientIP),
139					slog.String("user_agent", r.UserAgent()),
140					slog.String("username", username),
141					slog.String("request_uri", r.RequestURI),
142				)
143				response.JSONUnauthorized(w, r)
144				return
145			}
146	
147			user, err := m.store.UserByUsername(username)
148			if err != nil {
149				response.JSONServerError(w, r, err)
150				return
151			}
152	
153			if user == nil {
154				slog.Warn("[API] User not found while using Basic HTTP Authentication",
155					slog.Bool("authentication_failed", true),
156					slog.String("client_ip", clientIP),
157					slog.String("user_agent", r.UserAgent()),
158					slog.String("username", username),
159					slog.String("request_uri", r.RequestURI),
160				)
161				response.JSONUnauthorized(w, r)
162				return
163			}
164	
165			slog.Info("[API] User authenticated successfully with the Basic HTTP Authentication",
166				slog.Bool("authentication_successful", true),
167				slog.String("client_ip", clientIP),
168				slog.String("user_agent", r.UserAgent()),
169				slog.String("username", username),
170				slog.String("request_uri", r.RequestURI),
171			)
172	
173			m.store.SetLastLogin(user.ID)
174	
175			ctx := r.Context()
176			ctx = context.WithValue(ctx, request.UserIDContextKey, user.ID)
177			ctx = context.WithValue(ctx, request.UserTimezoneContextKey, user.Timezone)
178			ctx = context.WithValue(ctx, request.IsAdminUserContextKey, user.IsAdmin)
179			ctx = context.WithValue(ctx, request.IsAuthenticatedContextKey, true)
180	
181			next.ServeHTTP(w, r.WithContext(ctx))
182		})
183	}

// RegenerateAPIKey replaces the token of an API Key, which invalidates the previous one.
func (s *Storage) RegenerateAPIKey(userID, keyID int64) (*model.APIKey, error) {
	query := `
		UPDATE api_keys
		SET token=$1, last_used_at=NULL
		WHERE id=$2 AND user_id=$3
		RETURNING
			id, user_id, token, description, last_used_at, created_at
	`
	var apiKey model.APIKey
	err := s.db.QueryRow(
		query,
		crypto.GenerateRandomStringHex(32),
		keyID,
		userID,
	).Scan(
		&apiKey.ID,
		&apiKey.UserID,
		&apiKey.Token,
		&apiKey.Description,
		&apiKey.LastUsedAt,
		&apiKey.CreatedAt,
	)
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows):
		return nil, ErrAPIKeyNotFound
	case err != nil:
		return nil, fmt.Errorf(`store: unable to regenerate API Key: %v`, err)
	}

	return &apiKey, nil
}
